name: pan_update
description: Citizen wants to update details on their PAN card
context_question: I can help with a PAN update. Could you tell me what specifically needs to be changed — is it your name, date of birth, or something else?

name: aadhaar_update
description: Citizen wants to update details on their Aadhaar card
context_question: Sure, I can assist with an Aadhaar update. What detail would you like to update — address, mobile number, name, or something else?

name: pan_status
description: Citizen wants to check the status of their PAN card application
context_question: Happy to check that for you. When did you submit the PAN application, and have you received any acknowledgement number?

name: aadhaar_correction
description: Citizen wants to correct an error on their Aadhaar card
context_question: I'm sorry about the error. Can you describe what is incorrect on your Aadhaar — is it your name, date of birth, address, or something else?
